description.value:
You reach into the target's mind and rewire its cognitive architecture, leaving it permanently diminished. The target must attempt a Will save.

On a failure, the target is afflicted with a Cerebral Disruption curse chosen from the table below (d6 rolled by the GM or chosen thematically). On a success, the target suffers a lesser version. The curse persists indefinitely but can be ended by remove curse (rank 6 or higher) or a comparable restoration effect. The ability-score loss (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied}) can be repaired by a rank-7 or higher restoration spell.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for 24 hours.

Failure The target takes 9d6 mental damage and becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 4} permanently (until healed by restoration magic) and is afflicted with one Cerebral Disruption curse effect (d6): 1: @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 2} in the presence of a specified common object (phobia); 2: the target treats all creature-related checks as critically failed (mindlessly fails Intelligence-based skill checks about creatures); 3: the target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused]{Confused} (Incapacitation) for 1 minute, then freed — but re-encounters its Confusion-state periodically (save vs spell DC each day or be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused]{Confused} 1 round); 4: amnesia — cannot Recall Knowledge or use class abilities that require memory of training; 5: childlike mental regression — @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 4} and the GM controls the target's non-combat social behavior; 6: severe phobia of a common object the GM names.

Critical Failure As failure, and the target immediately becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Confused]{Confused} for 1 round (Incapacitation) and the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied} value is treated as @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 5} for the purpose of flat checks to Cast Spells this round.
